sql: SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.r, 0) - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) rev ON rev.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS f FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY o.employee_id) ref ON ref.eid = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(rt.c, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT c.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.id) WHERE rn = 2

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-06' AND substr(o.order_date,1,7) NOT BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) WHERE r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) / r24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 IS NOT NULL AND h24 > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(h25, 0) - h24) / h24 ASC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.c), 0) AS REAL) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS a FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), cust_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca JOIN cust_orders co ON co.customer_id = ca.customer_id WHERE ca.h > (SELECT a FROM overall) AND co.n >= 8
